description: Owners only (needs sign-in): Answer a customer's or another business's question (inquiry_id, from customer.message, updates or inquiries), or message a customer about a confirmed booking (booking_id). Latchbell relays it, and neither side sees the other's contact details until they book. Answer from what Latchbell knows and what the owner told you; ask the owner about anything else, and never negotiate prices. A question that came by text (via: text message) is answered by text: short and plain, no markdown. sent: false means it was already answered: don't retry. follow_up: true only when the owner wants another message. Up to 500 characters.

follow_up.description: Send even though the customer's latest message was already answered; only when the owner asked for another message

inquiry_id.description: Instead of booking_id: answer in a conversation

name: message_customer
title: Message the customer
